verdict.rationale: Visa publishes the Trusted Agent Protocol spec openly. It defines required RFC 9421 signature fields, tags, timestamp and nonce rules, and a public JWKS. It ships an open-licensed reference implementation (tap-agent, cdn-proxy verifier, merchant-backend, agent-registry) plus signature-base verification snippets. The Intelligent Commerce REST API is path-versioned (/acp/v1) with documented required fields. However, there is no evidence of a formal machine-readable schema, a protocol versioning or compatibility policy, or a dedicated conformance or validation test suite beyond sample code. The product is also flagged as still 'in the process of development and deployment.' Missing for 10: published machine-readable schema (OpenAPI/JSON Schema), explicit protocol version/compatibility policy, dedicated conformance or validation tooling, independent hands-on corroboration.
